text:
sarah: Kicking off soft launch for feature flag `session_cache_v2`. ramp: 5% -> 20% -> 50% over 30m/30m. holding at each step for telemetry checks. deploy window: now + 2h.
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout: session_cache_v2 -> cohorts [5%,20%,50%] at intervals [0m,30m,60m]. Success/err thresholds: 1.5% 5xx or 20% latency p95 increase -> AUTO-PAUSE.
miguel: Please pin model v2.1.3 on canary routing for this rollout. don't want mixing with v2.1.2.
sarah: Good call. pinning: routing.pin(model=session-encoder, version=v2.1.3, scope=canary) now.
anya: FYI I updated release notes with the opt-in behavior and migration steps: https://confluence/release/session_cache_v2
ops-oncall: Watching infra. heads-up: recent infra CPU spike on eu-west-1 during last similar rollout, keep an eye on host CPU > 85% metric.
leah: Can we add a fast-drain plan if error rate crosses 1.5%? we should have an immediate soft-disable command.
sarah: yes. fast-drain = `ffctl set session_cache_v2 0% --reason "auto-drain"` and routing fallback to session_cache_v1. deploy-bot: added rollback action hook -> run `ffctl` drain on threshold.
miguel: Also enabling verbose traces for 5% cohort for first 15m: `TRACE=session-cache:*` on canary. keep retention short.
ops-oncall: Metric note: set alert for 5xx-rate >= 1.2% over 5m (warn) and 1.5% over 3m (critical). latency p95 delta > +150ms -> warn.
sarah: During the 20% step we'll run synthetic prompts from perf harness. if latency p95 delta > +120ms we hold and triage.
deploy-bot: Cohort 5% started at 1754321000. ETA to next step 30m. Monitoring channels: #eng-releases, #prod-metrics.
anya: tagging product for user-visible changes: @oliver please glance at the copy in release notes.
ops-oncall: 1754321120 Alert: 5xx-rate 0.9% (warn). CPU normal. Continuing watch.
leah: small feedback: reduce cohort step to 15% instead of 20% if we see any noise at 5%.
sarah: ok we'll pause at 5% for an extra 10m if signals borderline, then move to 15% then 50%. updating rollout plan.
deploy-bot: Cohort step updated: [5%,15%,50%]. thresholds unchanged. Next step scheduled at 1754321300.
ops-oncall: 1754321245 Alert: p95 latency delta +180ms (critical for canary). Recommending pause + rollback to 0% while we triage.
miguel: I'm seeing increased KV cache miss rate tied to session encoding — possibly model mismatch. pin rollback to v2.1.2 for canary and drain flag.
sarah: Initiating soft-drain now: `ffctl set session_cache_v2 0% --reason "latency spike"`
deploy-bot: Action executed: session_cache_v2 -> 0% at 1754321260. Routing fallback to session_cache_v1.
ops-oncall: Confirming metrics: p95 back down to baseline in 90s. 5xx-rate dropping. good.
anya: Notifying customers on scheduled release channel and updating release notes to reflect quick rollback + follow-up postmortem.
leah: Postmortem owner? assigning to miguel + ops-oncall to triage model mismatch and rollout gating thresholds.
sarah: Thanks team. We'll re-evaluate kernel optimizations + tracing before attempting another ramp. Opening follow-up thread for postmortem and next rollout date.
